definitions.explanation: Describes a person or constitution that is physically weak and prone to illness. Often refers to an inherent or chronic condition of poor health.

examples.japanese: {虚弱|きょじゃく}⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虚弱|きょじゃく}だった。
examples.english: I was frail as a child.

examples.japanese: {虚弱|きょじゃく}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started exercising daily to overcome my weak constitution.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {虚弱|きょじゃく}な⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧.

MEDICAL CONTEXT: {虚弱|きょじゃく}⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧ (weak constitution) is a common medical/health term describing someone prone to illness.

NUANCE: {虚弱|きょじゃく} typically describes an inherent weakness rather than temporary illness. It's often used for children or people with chronic health issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虚弱|きょじゃく}⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧ (weak constitution)
- {虚弱|きょじゃく}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (frail body)
- {虚弱|きょじゃく}な⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧ (sickly child)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (weak - more common)
- ⟦{病弱|びょうじゃく}→病弱：13612_byoujaku⟧ (sickly, delicate - similar)
- ⟦{頑健|がんけん}→頑健：09197_ganken⟧ (sturdy, robust - opposite)
- ⟦{壮健|そうけん}→壮健：09195_souken⟧ (healthy, robust - opposite)
